# Versions

The protocol generations, their hotfixes, and their version numbers. This page holds the full text of the live definitions of the group, from [README.md](../README.md).

<a id="d-02"></a>

## D-02: Protocol generation `[EVOLVING]`

> One iteration of the Zama protocol, named today by its major and minor version numbers.

Aliases: generation.

A protocol generation is one iteration of the Zama protocol. Each new generation replaces the current one. Today, the major and minor version numbers name a generation, and every release of that generation shares them:

| Generation    | Releases |
| ------------- | -------- |
| protocol v13  | `0.13.x` |
| protocol v14  | `0.14.x` |
| protocol v1.0 | `1.0.x`  |

This definition describes the protocol as it works now. If the protocol design changes, what makes a new generation and how a generation is numbered can change too.

Internal text names a generation by its place, as in `<vN>` or `<vN-1>`, never by its number. [R-05](../../rules/entries/R-05.md) gives the notation.

<a id="d-03"></a>

## D-03: Protocol hotfix `[STABLE]`

> A fix to one protocol generation that leaves the generation unchanged.

Aliases: hotfix.

A protocol hotfix fixes one protocol generation. A hotfix changes only the patch number, so the generation stays the same. For example, `0.13.6` is a hotfix of protocol v13.

<a id="d-04"></a>

## D-04: Protocol version `[STABLE]`

> A name that usually means the protocol generation.

Aliases: version.

"Protocol version" usually means the protocol generation. To name one hotfix, write the full version number, such as `0.13.6`.
